host: Windows with Go 1.27.3 and a local TEI checkout
command: go run ./tools/reference-generator-selection/cmd/tei-generator-build -contract <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/document-record/contract.json -strategy text-record-template -out <tmp>/text-record-template && go run ./tools/reference-generator-selection/cmd/tei-generator-select -workspace <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document -contract <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/document-record/contract.json -fixtures <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/candidates/document-record/fixtures.json -candidates <tmp> && go run ./tools/reference-target-profile/cmd/tei-target-profile run -profile <TAI>/integrations/pilot-sui-document/profiles/record.json ...
scope: A reference-local flat record contract for SUI Document metadata. Card, Island, and Edge remain separate flat records composed by the application; no nested Document projection, SUI code, real target, or human acceptance is shown.
